title: Git Visualization
content: I developed a Git commit visualization. It's almost identical to the GitHub commit visualization but it also shows commit messages and you can use multiple square colors. Some of the projects on this page have one of these visualizations indicated by a green Git link. These visualizations require a browser width of at least 1,200 pixels.

title: Static Site Generator
content: I made a static site generator for this portfolio site you are currently viewing. If you run the generator without modification, then you will get this exact site. But it is easy to change the data in order to generate a different website.

title: Internet Forum
content: This is an internet forum that I develop. It has posts and nested comments. The nested comments use the PostgreSQL ltree module. It has an OAuth 2 JSON API. There are subs/communities and hashtags. Each sub can have a different moderator. There are also direct messages.

title: React Table Component
content: I programmed a React table component. It displays an array of arrays or an array of object literals as an HTML table. You can edit table cells. If you use object literals you can sort by columns. I asked a question about this project on Reddit.
